senses.en: to deal with a problem or issue
senses.pattern: address a problem / address an issue / address concerns
senses.example: The school hired two more counselors to [[address]] the growing problem of stress among students.
senses.example_zh: 學校多聘了兩位輔導老師，以處理學生壓力日益嚴重的問題。

senses.en: a formal speech given to an audience
senses.pattern: deliver an address / an opening address / a commencement address
senses.example: The principal's opening [[address]] at the graduation ceremony lasted only five minutes but moved everyone.
senses.example_zh: 校長在畢業典禮上的開場致詞只有五分鐘，卻感動了所有人。
senses.note: 亦作動詞：address the audience 向聽眾演說

gsat.sentence: It was not until Grover Cleveland’s first presidency that some effective crowd control measures were implemented to [[address]] the problem caused by this practice.
The speaker was Robot Redford, a robot who delivered the commencement [[address]] at a community college in suburban Maryland.

senses.en: special care or treatment given to someone or something
senses.pattern: medical attention / need urgent attention / care and attention
senses.example: The injured hiker needed immediate medical [[attention]], so the rescue team flew him to the nearest hospital.
senses.example_zh: 受傷的登山客需要立刻接受治療，搜救隊於是將他空運到最近的醫院。

senses.en: a position of standing straight and still, as soldiers do
senses.pattern: stand at attention / come to attention / stand to attention
senses.example: The young soldiers stood at [[attention]] as the general walked slowly down the line.
senses.example_zh: 將軍沿著隊伍緩緩走過時，年輕的士兵們都以立正姿勢站好。

gsat.sentence: A new relationship is like an embryo that requires time, care and [[attention]] to grow into whatever may evolve.

senses.en: to officially prevent someone from doing something
senses.pattern: bar sb from doing sth / be barred from entering / bar sb's way
senses.example: After the cheating scandal, the two players were [[barred]] from competing in any national tournament for a year.
senses.example_zh: 作弊醜聞爆發後，這兩名選手一年內被禁止參加任何全國性賽事。

senses.en: a long piece of metal in a cage or window
senses.pattern: the bars of a cage / iron bars / behind bars
senses.example: The little monkey reached through the [[bars]] of its cage to grab a banana from the keeper.
senses.example_zh: 小猴子把手伸出籠子的鐵條，從飼養員手中抓走一根香蕉。

gsat.sentence: When photographing zoo animals, don’t get too close to the cages, and never tap on the glass or throw things between the [[bars]] of a cage.

senses.en: the regular rhythm of a piece of music
senses.pattern: the beat of the drum / dance to the beat / keep the beat / a steady beat
senses.example: The children clapped their hands to the [[beat]] of the drum as the parade passed by.
senses.example_zh: 遊行隊伍經過時，孩子們跟著鼓聲的節拍拍手。

senses.en: very tired; with no energy left
senses.pattern: be dead beat / feel beat / look beat
senses.example: After hiking for ten hours in the rain, we were too [[beat]] to cook dinner.
senses.example_zh: 在雨中健行十個小時後，我們筋疲力盡，連晚餐都沒力氣煮。
senses.note: 口語用法，不放在名詞前

senses.en: the feature that makes something especially good
senses.pattern: the beauty of the plan / the beauty of it is that / that's the beauty of it
senses.example: The [[beauty]] of this app is that it works perfectly even without an internet connection.
senses.example_zh: 這個應用程式的妙處在於沒有網路也能正常運作。
senses.note: 常用 the beauty of A is that …

senses.en: to describe someone unfairly as something bad
senses.pattern: be branded a liar / brand sb as a troublemaker / be branded a failure
senses.example: After failing one important test, the boy was unfairly [[branded]] a lazy student by some of his teachers.
senses.example_zh: 一次重要考試不及格後，那個男孩就被一些老師不公平地貼上懶惰學生的標籤。

senses.en: to mark an animal with a hot iron
senses.pattern: brand cattle / brand a calf / be branded with a mark
senses.example: In the past, ranchers [[branded]] their cattle with a hot iron to show who owned them.
senses.example_zh: 從前牧場主人會用燒紅的鐵在牛身上打烙印，以表明牛是誰的。

senses.en: money or property used to start or run a business
senses.pattern: raise capital / start-up capital / invest capital / a lack of capital
senses.example: The young couple needed more [[capital]] to open a second bakery near the train station.
senses.example_zh: 這對年輕夫妻需要更多資金，才能在火車站附近開第二家麵包店。

senses.en: a letter in its large form, such as A
senses.pattern: in capitals / in block capitals / a capital letter / begin with a capital
senses.example: Please write your full name in [[capitals]] at the top of the application form.
senses.example_zh: 請在申請表上方用大寫字母寫下你的全名。

gsat.sentence: This comparative advantage is determined by key factors of production such as land, [[capital]], and labor.

senses.en: an aim or principle that people support or fight for
senses.pattern: a good cause / a worthy cause / fight for a cause / the cause of peace
senses.example: She has devoted her whole life to the [[cause]] of protecting endangered sea turtles.
senses.example_zh: 她把一生都奉獻給保護瀕危海龜這個目標。
senses.note: for a good cause：為了公益、做善事

senses.en: a good reason for feeling or doing something
senses.pattern: cause for concern / cause for celebration / without good cause
senses.example: The doctor said the test results were normal, so there was no [[cause]] for concern.
senses.example_zh: 醫生說檢查結果正常，所以沒有擔心的理由。
senses.note: 此義不可數，常接 for＋名詞

senses.en: a way of sending information or getting something done
senses.pattern: through official channels / the proper channels / channels of communication / a sales channel
senses.example: Complaints about school lunches should be made through the proper [[channels]], not on social media.
senses.example_zh: 對學校午餐的申訴應該透過正式管道提出，而不是發在社群媒體上。

senses.en: to direct money, energy, or feelings toward a purpose
senses.pattern: channel energy into / channel anger into / channel funds into
senses.example: The coach taught the boy to [[channel]] his anger into training harder on the field.
senses.example_zh: 教練教那個男孩把怒氣投注於球場上更刻苦的訓練。

senses.en: a passage of water that ships can travel along
senses.pattern: a deep channel / a shipping channel / a narrow channel / the English Channel
senses.example: Large ships must follow a narrow [[channel]] to enter the harbor safely at low tide.
senses.example_zh: 退潮時，大型船隻必須沿著狹窄的水道才能安全進港。

gsat.sentence: The pilot is needed to direct large ships into a port, where there are often deep water [[channels]] surrounded by shallower seabeds.
When the [[channel]] is not deep enough.

senses.en: to catch or develop an illness
senses.pattern: contract a disease / contract a virus / contract malaria
senses.example: Travelers to tropical regions may [[contract]] malaria if they are bitten by infected mosquitoes.
senses.example_zh: 前往熱帶地區的旅客若被帶原的蚊子叮咬，可能會感染瘧疾。

senses.en: to become smaller, shorter, or tighter
senses.pattern: muscles contract / metal contracts / the economy contracted
senses.example: Metal [[contracts]] as it cools, which is why bridges are built with small gaps between sections.
senses.example_zh: 金屬冷卻時會收縮，這就是橋梁各段之間留有小縫隙的原因。

gsat.sentence: Over 20% of people who [[contract]] it will suffer severe symptoms.
The increasing population in Texas raised the risk of [[contracting]] the disease.

senses.en: to try hard to win someone's support or business
senses.pattern: court customers / court voters / court sb's support / court publicity
senses.example: Coffee shops near the campus are [[courting]] students with cheap breakfast sets and free wireless internet.
senses.example_zh: 校園附近的咖啡店推出便宜的早餐套餐和免費無線網路，極力爭取學生顧客。

senses.en: the place where a king or queen lives and rules
senses.pattern: the royal court / at court / the court of the emperor
senses.example: The young musician was invited to perform at the royal [[court]] when he was only six.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕的音樂家年僅六歲就受邀到王室宮廷演奏。

gsat.sentence: A lover of tea since her childhood in Portugal, she brought tea-drinking to the English royal [[court]] and set a trend for the beverage in the seventeenth century.
By the 7th century A.D., royal [[courts]] of the Middle East began to use forks at the table for dining.

senses.en: a shape with four equal sloping sides
senses.pattern: a diamond shape / a diamond pattern / cut into diamonds
senses.example: The road sign was a yellow [[diamond]] with a black arrow pointing to the left.
senses.example_zh: 那個路標是一個黃色的菱形，上面有指向左邊的黑色箭頭。
senses.note: 撲克牌的「方塊」也叫 diamonds

senses.en: a baseball field, especially the infield
senses.pattern: a baseball diamond / on the diamond / around the diamond
senses.example: The children spent every summer afternoon playing baseball on the dusty [[diamond]] behind the school.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們每個夏日午後都在學校後面那座塵土飛揚的棒球場上打棒球。

senses.en: to make pain or a problem less severe
senses.pattern: ease the pain / ease tension / ease traffic congestion / ease sb's worries
senses.example: A cup of warm ginger tea may help [[ease]] a sore throat on cold winter nights.
senses.example_zh: 在寒冷的冬夜，一杯溫熱的薑茶或許有助於減輕喉嚨痛。

senses.en: to move something slowly and carefully
senses.pattern: ease the car into / ease the door open / ease yourself into a chair
senses.example: The driver slowly [[eased]] the huge truck through the narrow gate without touching either side.
senses.example_zh: 司機小心緩慢地把大卡車開過窄門，兩邊都沒有碰到。

gsat.sentence: Research shows that modest amounts of exercise—even just 15 minutes a day—helps [[ease]] depression, enhance self-image, relieve stress, and much more.
The report concludes with an earnest request to international policymakers to distribute financial and other resources to [[ease]] the regional crisis.

senses.en: one of the races or contests in a sports competition
senses.pattern: a track event / field events / the 100-meter event / compete in three events
senses.example: She won gold medals in two swimming [[events]] at last year's national games.
senses.example_zh: 她在去年全國運動會的兩個游泳比賽項目中奪得金牌。

senses.en: the person or team expected to win
senses.pattern: the favorite to win / the clear favorite / the hot favorite / the favorite for the title
senses.example: Having won her last ten matches, she is the clear [[favorite]] to take the gold medal.
senses.example_zh: 她已連贏十場比賽，顯然是最被看好的奪金熱門。
senses.note: 相反詞 underdog 不被看好者

senses.en: a business company
senses.pattern: a law firm / an accounting firm / a consulting firm / a firm of architects
senses.example: After graduating from law school, Diane joined a small [[firm]] that helps people start their own businesses.
senses.example_zh: 黛安從法學院畢業後，加入了一家協助人們創業的小型事務所。

gsat.sentence: Moreover, a number of [[firms]] are creating cars that drive themselves to a chosen destination without a human at the controls.
Next, we sold the computers off to Stab, Grab, Grit, and Nasty, a [[firm]] of lawyers nearby.

senses.en: a sudden short attack of emotion, coughing, or laughter
senses.pattern: a fit of anger / a coughing fit / in a fit of jealousy
senses.example: In a [[fit]] of anger, the boy threw his phone on the floor and cracked the screen.
senses.example_zh: 男孩一時怒氣發作，把手機摔在地上，螢幕都裂了。

senses.en: suitable or good enough for a purpose
senses.pattern: fit to drink / fit to eat / fit for human consumption
senses.example: After the flood, the tap water was not [[fit]] to drink for nearly a week.
senses.example_zh: 水災過後，自來水有將近一週都不適合飲用。
senses.note: 句型：be fit to V／fit for N

senses.en: after or as a result of an event
senses.pattern: following the earthquake / following the announcement / following a complaint
senses.example: [[Following]] the heavy rain, several mountain roads were closed to traffic for two days.
senses.example_zh: 在大雨之後，好幾條山路封閉了兩天，禁止車輛通行。
senses.note: 比 after 正式，常見於新聞

senses.en: a group of supporters or fans
senses.pattern: a large following / a loyal following / build a following / attract a following
senses.example: The tiny bookstore has a devoted [[following]] among local students, who gather there every weekend.
senses.example_zh: 這家小書店在當地學生當中有一群死忠的擁護者，他們每個週末都聚在那裡。

senses.en: larger or more than usual or expected
senses.pattern: a generous portion / a generous amount of / a generous helping / generous leg room
senses.example: The restaurant is famous for serving [[generous]] portions, so most customers cannot finish their meals.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳以餐點分量豐盛聞名，所以大多數客人都吃不完。

senses.en: affecting only one part of the body
senses.pattern: a local anesthetic / under local anesthesia / a local infection
senses.example: The dentist gave Ben a [[local]] anesthetic, so he stayed awake but felt no pain.
senses.example_zh: 牙醫為班施打局部麻醉，所以他保持清醒卻不覺得痛。

senses.en: a person who lives in a particular area
senses.pattern: ask the locals / popular with locals / locals and tourists
senses.example: If you want to find the best noodle shop in town, just ask the [[locals]].
senses.example_zh: 如果你想找鎮上最好吃的麵店，問當地人就對了。

senses.en: a small glass ball used in children's games
senses.pattern: play marbles / a bag of marbles / a glass marble
senses.example: The children knelt on the ground, taking turns shooting glass [[marbles]] into a small hole.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們跪在地上，輪流把玻璃彈珠彈進一個小洞裡。
senses.note: 此義可數；play marbles 打彈珠

senses.en: an animal's partner for producing young
senses.pattern: attract a mate / find a mate / choose a mate / compete for mates
senses.example: The male peacock spreads its colorful tail feathers to attract a [[mate]] during the spring.
senses.example_zh: 雄孔雀在春天時會展開色彩繽紛的尾羽來吸引配偶。

senses.en: (of animals) to come together to produce young
senses.pattern: mate with / mate for life / the mating season
senses.example: Many swans [[mate]] for life and raise their young together year after year.
senses.example_zh: 許多天鵝終生只與同一個伴侶交配，年復一年地共同撫育幼雛。

gsat.sentence: To me, a zoo can be a good place for endangered species which have difficulty finding suitable [[mates]] in the wild.
They [[mate]] at night near railways.

senses.en: a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting
senses.pattern: propose a motion / pass a motion / second a motion / reject a motion
senses.example: The student council passed a [[motion]] to extend library hours during exam week.
senses.example_zh: 學生會通過了一項在考試週延長圖書館開放時間的動議。

senses.en: to signal to someone with your hand or head
senses.pattern: motion (for) sb to do sth / motion to sb / motion sb to a seat
senses.example: The librarian [[motioned]] for us to lower our voices and pointed at the sign.
senses.example_zh: 圖書館員打手勢示意我們降低音量，並指了指告示。

senses.en: to get over or through a difficult place successfully
senses.pattern: negotiate a sharp bend / negotiate the stairs / negotiate rough ground
senses.example: The bus driver slowed down to [[negotiate]] a series of sharp bends on the mountain road.
senses.example_zh: 公車司機放慢速度，以順利通過山路上一連串的急彎。

gsat.sentence: But baby elephants, not used to [[negotiating]] rough ground, may easily fall into the trenches and get hurt; and once injured, they might not be able to climb out.

senses.en: how well a person or organization does something
senses.pattern: academic performance / job performance / a strong performance / improve performance
senses.example: Getting enough sleep can greatly improve students' academic [[performance]], according to a recent study.
senses.example_zh: 根據最近一項研究，睡眠充足能大幅提升學生的學業表現。

senses.en: how well a machine or vehicle works
senses.pattern: engine performance / high performance / battery performance / improve the performance of
senses.example: The new battery design improves the [[performance]] of electric cars in extremely cold weather.
senses.example_zh: 新的電池設計提升了電動車在嚴寒天氣中的性能。

gsat.sentence: Jack’s excellent [[performance]] in last week’s game has erased all the doubts about his ability to play on our school basketball team.
There is, however, a significant gap between such beliefs and the actual effect of weather on people’s [[performance]] at work.

senses.en: to burst, or make something burst, with a short sound
senses.pattern: pop a balloon / the balloon popped / pop popcorn
senses.example: The little boy cried when his red balloon touched a rose bush and [[popped]].
senses.example_zh: 小男孩的紅氣球碰到玫瑰叢，砰的一聲爆開，他就哭了。

senses.en: to appear or go somewhere suddenly or quickly
senses.pattern: pop up / pop into the store / pop out for lunch
senses.example: A warning message [[popped]] up on the screen just as I was about to save my report.
senses.example_zh: 我正要儲存報告時，螢幕上突然出現一則警告訊息。
senses.note: 口語用法；後接 up, in, out 等副詞

gsat.sentence: When the kernels start [[popping]], shake the pot to let the steam escape and to let the unpopped kernels fall to the bottom.
Make sure you don’t squeeze or [[pop]] a stye like you would a pimple.

senses.en: to create a threat, problem, or danger
senses.pattern: pose a threat to / pose a risk / pose a challenge / pose a problem
senses.example: Plastic waste in the ocean [[poses]] a serious danger to sea turtles and seabirds.
senses.example_zh: 海洋中的塑膠垃圾對海龜和海鳥構成嚴重的危險。

senses.en: to pretend to be someone else to trick people
senses.pattern: pose as a police officer / pose as a customer / pose as a doctor
senses.example: The thief [[posed]] as a repairman to get inside the old couple's apartment.
senses.example_zh: 那名小偷假冒修理工人，混進了那對老夫婦的公寓。

senses.en: to ask a question that needs careful thought
senses.pattern: pose a question / pose a question to sb / the questions posed by
senses.example: At the end of her talk, the speaker [[posed]] a question that nobody could answer.
senses.example_zh: 演講結束時，講者提出了一個沒有人答得出來的問題。

gsat.sentence: Sometimes referred to as secret shoppers, mystery shoppers [[pose]] as regular customers to purchase items, eat in restaurants, make inquiries, or return items.
The organization believes that people may be motivated to buy elephant-friendly brands when they know more about the risk tea can [[pose]] to these endangered animals.

senses.en: completely sure that something is true
senses.pattern: be positive that… / be positive about sth / absolutely positive
senses.example: Are you [[positive]] that the meeting is on Friday? I thought it had been moved to Thursday.
senses.example_zh: 你確信會議是在星期五嗎？我以為已經改到星期四了。

senses.en: showing that a substance or disease is present
senses.pattern: test positive for sth / a positive result / a positive reading
senses.example: Two players tested [[positive]] for the flu and had to stay home for a week.
senses.example_zh: 兩名球員流感檢驗呈陽性，必須在家休息一週。

gsat.sentence: Can one of these energy drinks really cause someone to test [[positive]] on an ABT?
A “[[positive]]” test result, a result over the legal limit, allows the police to arrest the driver.

senses.en: a job, or the place where someone is on duty
senses.pattern: take up a post / a teaching post / hold a post / leave your post
senses.example: After ten years as a nurse, she took up a new [[post]] as head of the clinic.
senses.example_zh: 當了十年護理師後，她接下診所主任這個新職位。

senses.en: to send someone to work somewhere for a time
senses.pattern: be posted to / be posted abroad / be posted overseas
senses.example: Her father, an engineer, was [[posted]] to Vietnam for three years to manage a new factory.
senses.example_zh: 她的父親是工程師，被派駐越南三年，負責管理一座新工廠。
senses.note: 多用被動 be posted to＋地點

senses.en: a strong upright pole fixed in the ground
senses.pattern: a fence post / a wooden post / a goal post / a lamp post
senses.example: He tied his horse to a wooden [[post]] in front of the store and went inside.
senses.example_zh: 他把馬拴在店門前的一根木樁上，然後走了進去。

gsat.sentence: Totem poles in North America are poles or [[posts]] carved with symbols or figures by Aboriginal peoples of the Northwest Coast.

senses.en: used to introduce a contrasting, more accurate idea
senses.pattern: not A; rather, B / not… but rather… / rather, it is…
senses.example: The trip was not a waste of time; [[rather]], it taught us how to work together.
senses.example_zh: 這趟旅行並非浪費時間；相反地，它教會了我們如何合作。

senses.en: used to correct or improve what was just said
senses.pattern: A, or rather B / or rather, I should say
senses.example: She arrived late last night, or [[rather]], early this morning at around two.
senses.example_zh: 她昨天深夜才到，更確切地說，是今天凌晨兩點左右。

gsat.sentence: [[Rather]] it is PBS, Public Broadcasting System, a non-profit public broadcasting TV service.

senses.en: to become aware of something without being told
senses.pattern: sense danger / sense that… / sense sb's presence / sense trouble
senses.example: Dogs can often [[sense]] that an earthquake is coming minutes before people feel anything.
senses.example_zh: 狗往往能在人們有任何感覺的幾分鐘前，就察覺地震即將來臨。

senses.en: one of the meanings of a word or phrase
senses.pattern: in a sense / in the sense that / in the strict sense / in every sense of the word
senses.example: The word "bank" has two [[senses]]: a place for money and the side of a river.
senses.example_zh: bank 這個字有兩個意義：存錢的地方和河岸。

senses.en: good judgment; a sound reason for something
senses.pattern: common sense / make sense / have the sense to do sth / there is no sense in
senses.example: Luckily, Ben had the [[sense]] to turn off the gas before running out of the kitchen.
senses.example_zh: 幸好班夠理智，在跑出廚房前先把瓦斯關掉。

gsat.sentence: None of them wanted to—though for some years afterwards I was left in no doubt that I was morally obliged to them, in the [[sense]] that it always seemed to be my round when it came to the buying of drinks.
If a serious injury is ruled out and the pain is not getting worse after exercising, then the exercise “makes a lot of [[sense]].”

senses.en: to be used for a purpose or have a certain effect
senses.pattern: serve as a reminder / serve as a warning / serve to show
senses.example: The old railway station now [[serves]] as a museum that tells the history of the town.
senses.example_zh: 那座舊火車站如今充當博物館，訴說這座城鎮的歷史。
senses.note: serve as＋名詞；serve to＋原形動詞

senses.en: to work in an official position or the armed forces
senses.pattern: serve in the army / serve on a committee / serve as mayor
senses.example: Before becoming a writer, Mr. Kato [[served]] in the navy for eight years as a ship's engineer.
senses.example_zh: 成為作家之前，加藤先生在海軍服役了八年，擔任輪機員。

gsat.sentence: But pineapples can also be a fashionable fruit: Pineapple leaves can [[serve]] as a substitute for leather.
In some countries, military service is compulsory for men only; women do not have to [[serve]] in the military.

senses.en: a metal case filled with explosives, fired from a large gun
senses.pattern: an artillery shell / an unexploded shell / fire shells / a shell exploded
senses.example: Workers building the new road found an unexploded [[shell]] left over from a war decades ago.
senses.example_zh: 修築新道路的工人發現了一枚數十年前戰爭遺留下來的未爆砲彈。
senses.note: 動詞 shell 亦指「砲擊」

senses.en: to remove the shell from nuts, peas, or seafood
senses.pattern: shell peas / shell peanuts / shell shrimp / shelled nuts
senses.example: Grandma sat by the window, [[shelling]] peas for dinner while listening to the radio.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶坐在窗邊，一邊聽收音機，一邊給晚餐要用的豌豆去殼。

senses.en: living in groups rather than alone
senses.pattern: social animals / social insects / highly social species
senses.example: Ants are [[social]] insects that live in large colonies and share the work of finding food.
senses.example_zh: 螞蟻是群居的昆蟲，生活在龐大的蟻群中，並分工覓食。

gsat.sentence: They are highly [[social]] birds and often travel in large flocks.

senses.en: a device that sound comes out of
senses.pattern: a wireless speaker / a pair of speakers / a smart speaker / speaker volume
senses.example: The music from the [[speakers]] was so loud that we could not hear each other talk.
senses.example_zh: 喇叭傳出的音樂太大聲，我們都聽不見彼此說話。

senses.en: the person who leads debates in a parliament
senses.pattern: the Speaker of the House / be elected Speaker / the Speaker of Parliament
senses.example: The [[Speaker]] of the parliament asked the members to stop shouting and return to their seats.
senses.example_zh: 國會議長要求議員們停止叫喊並回到座位上。

gsat.sentence: Researchers in Japan have installed on a train a [[speaker]] that barks like a dog and snorts like a deer in order to prevent collisions with animals on the tracks.

senses.en: a small bird with pointed wings and a forked tail
senses.pattern: a flock of swallows / a swallow's nest / swallows return in spring
senses.example: Each spring, [[swallows]] return to build their nests under the roof of our old house.
senses.example_zh: 每年春天，燕子都會回到我們老家的屋簷下築巢。

senses.en: to hold back a feeling such as anger or pride
senses.pattern: swallow one's pride / swallow one's anger / swallow an insult
senses.example: Mark [[swallowed]] his anger and calmly explained the rule to the rude customer once more.
senses.example_zh: 馬克忍住怒氣，心平氣和地再向那位無禮的顧客解釋一次規定。
senses.note: swallow one's pride 放下自尊、拉下臉

senses.en: a mass of similar cells forming part of a body
senses.pattern: muscle tissue / brain tissue / damaged tissue / scar tissue
senses.example: Regular exercise helps the body build muscle [[tissue]] and repair cells damaged during the day.
senses.example_zh: 規律運動有助於身體增生肌肉組織，並修復白天受損的細胞。

gsat.sentence: Most of them act as cleaners for other fish and pick dead [[tissue]] from their bodies.

senses.en: a word or name that shows someone's rank or job
senses.pattern: the title of professor / a job title / hold the title of / a royal title
senses.example: She was given the [[title]] of professor after twenty years of teaching and research.
senses.example_zh: 她從事教學與研究二十年後，獲得了教授的頭銜。

senses.en: the position of champion in a sports competition
senses.pattern: win the title / defend the title / a world title / a national title
senses.example: The young swimmer won her first national [[title]] at the age of sixteen.
senses.example_zh: 這名年輕泳將十六歲時贏得她的第一個全國冠軍。

gsat.sentence: This was to ensure that no single and powerful noble family could seize the [[title]] and pass it to the next generation.

senses.en: the act of raising glasses to honor someone
senses.pattern: propose a toast / make a toast to / drink a toast
senses.example: At the wedding dinner, the bride's father proposed a [[toast]] to the happy couple.
senses.example_zh: 婚宴上，新娘的父親提議向這對幸福的新人敬酒。

senses.en: to raise a glass and drink in honor of someone
senses.pattern: toast the bride and groom / toast sb's success / toast the new year
senses.example: The whole team raised their glasses of juice and [[toasted]] the coach on her sixtieth birthday.
senses.example_zh: 全隊舉起果汁，向過六十歲生日的教練舉杯祝賀。

senses.en: faithful and loyal to someone or something
senses.pattern: be true to one's word / stay true to oneself / remain true to one's beliefs
senses.example: She stayed [[true]] to her word and returned every dollar she had borrowed.
senses.example_zh: 她忠實信守諾言，把借來的每一塊錢都還清了。

senses.en: applying correctly to a person or situation
senses.pattern: hold true / be true of sb / the same is true for…
senses.example: Cats love to sleep in warm places, and the same is [[true]] of many dogs.
senses.example_zh: 貓喜歡睡在溫暖的地方，這一點也適用於許多狗。

gsat.sentence: But does this hold [[true]] across time and cultures?

quiz.stem: The speaker had to pause in the middle of her talk when a sudden ______ of coughing left her unable to say a word.
quiz.explain_zh: fit＝（咳嗽等）一陣發作。講者突然一陣猛咳，話都說不出來，只好暫停演講。

quiz.stem: After swimming in the polluted lake during the camping trip, three students ______ a serious skin infection and needed medical treatment.
quiz.explain_zh: contract＝感染（疾病）。三名學生在受污染的湖裡游泳後染上嚴重的皮膚感染。

quiz.stem: Mrs. Lin is ______ that she turned off the stove before leaving home, because she clearly remembers checking it twice.
quiz.explain_zh: positive＝確信的。林太太記得檢查過兩次，所以確信瓦斯爐已關。

quiz.stem: The burn was so serious that doctors had to remove the damaged ______ and cover the wound with healthy skin from the patient's leg.
quiz.explain_zh: tissue＝（生物）組織。燒傷嚴重，醫生必須切除受損組織，再用腿部的健康皮膚覆蓋傷口。

quiz.stem: The two college friends had a brilliant idea for a language-learning app, but without enough ______ to hire engineers, they had to borrow money from their families.
quiz.explain_zh: capital＝資金。兩人沒有足夠資金聘請工程師，只好向家人借錢。

quiz.stem: Since last month, large trucks have been ______ from the old bridge because engineers found cracks in its main supports.
quiz.explain_zh: bar＝禁止。工程師發現舊橋的主要支撐結構有裂縫，大卡車被禁止上橋。

quiz.stem: Thousands of runners signed up for the charity marathon because they believed in its ______: raising money to build a children's hospital.
quiz.explain_zh: cause＝（奮鬥的）目標、理想。跑者認同這場馬拉松募款蓋兒童醫院的目標。

quiz.stem: To find out how the shop cheated foreign visitors, the reporter ______ as a tourist and secretly recorded the whole conversation.
quiz.explain_zh: pose＝（pose as）假冒。記者假冒觀光客，查出商店如何欺騙外國遊客。

quiz.stem: Although the singer has never appeared on television, she has attracted a loyal ______ of young listeners through her live shows in small coffee shops.
quiz.explain_zh: following＝追隨者（總稱）。這位歌手靠現場演出吸引了一群忠實的年輕聽眾。

quiz.stem: The rescue robot is designed to ______ stairs, piles of broken concrete, and other obstacles that would stop an ordinary wheeled machine.
quiz.explain_zh: negotiate＝順利通過（難行處）。救難機器人能越過樓梯、瓦礫堆等障礙。
